about_the_game:
In D.E.W., Players become Delta Epsilon Warriors to battle their friends in this multiplayer twin stick shooter.

Competitors will duke it out in a battle of wits, where it’s not about shooting where your targets are, it’s about shooting where they will be. N.E.O. rifles work a little different than traditional energy blasters. The stream of plasma fired will crawl around the arena and ricochet off walls, leaving a lethal trail behind for others to run into. Players need to think ahead to cut off their opponent’s escape route, leaving them vulnerable to the kill shot.

Score enough kills, or just outlast the competition to secure the victory.

D.E.W. supports up to 4 players local or online, with several arenas, game modes, and weapons to choose from. Matches are fast and cutthroat, meaning victory, or defeat, are always just around the corner.

Deny. Eliminate. Win. Join the fight, and become a Delta Epsilon Warrior today.

short_description: Become a Delta Epsilon Warrior and battle your friends in this fast paced, twin-stick arena shooter. Plan your shots carefully and cut off your target's escape route with your hazard creating lasers. Deny. Eliminate. Win. Join the fight and outwit and outmanoeuvre your way to victory.
